stage1.impression: A warm, low-key kissa-style bar with a convincing record wall and two big speakers set into timber niches, and it gets the dim, pooled-light mood right. The people are what make it read as CG: pale grey-green mannequins with blank pink heads, smeared by the motion blur, and they are the brightest and largest objects in the middle of the frame. The zinc top is a smooth, flat, pale slab, the tub chairs are untextured, and the left niche has a white blown reflection that looks like a window. It reads as a decent interior render, not a photograph. A magazine would see the beginning of a specific place (speakers built into the record wall like a Tokyo listening bar), but the shell it describes, board-formed concrete, fir beams and blackened steel, barely shows, so for now it reads as a generic dark-timber bar.

blocking_9: The figures must read as real people photographed at a slow shutter (dark, varied clothing, hair, hands, proportion), not as pale low-poly mannequins, and must not be the brightest mass in the frame: region [380,300,700,580] lum_median <= 75, now 116.5
The speakers must be the hero. The left niche speaker [160,230,340,550] needs lum_median >= 60 (now 44.6) and must out-read the figures in front of the right one
The zinc counter top must read as aged zinc (patina, wipe marks, soft uneven sheen, a rolled nosing), not smooth grey plaster
No blown, window-like white reflection in the left niche's top [240,150,340,220]
The shell's signature materials (board-formed concrete, fir beam checks, blackened steel) must be legible somewhere in the frame, so the room reads as this place, not a generic bar
Foreground chairs [900,600,1200,800] with leather or wool texture and no crushed flat shapes

defects.what: Two standing figures are pale grey-green mannequins with featureless salmon heads, no hair or hands. The blur smears them into ghosts, and at lum_median 116 they are the brightest mass in the frame
Seated guest at the right is a grey mannequin with a doubled, ghosted head; it reads as a game asset
Large white, sky-like reflection on the acrylic or glass at the top of the left niche (p95 224). It reads as a window in a niche that has none
Zinc counter top is a uniform, smooth, matte light-grey slab with no patina, wipe marks or edge wear; it reads as plaster or a CG plane
Foreground tub chairs are flat, untextured tan and grey shapes, crush 7.4 %; no leather grain or seams
Left speaker under-lit (lum_median 44.6), a grey box behind glass; tinted cast acrylic and horn barely read
Right speaker is cut by the selector's blurred body and arm, so the pair does not read as a pair
Record spines and shelf edges are slightly smeared by the denoiser at 1:1
Ceiling beams read as uniform brown boxes; no checks, nail holes or end grain visible, and no concrete visible anywhere in frame
Record-player lids read as a thin grey glass box with a flat light-grey band, more display case than thick polished acrylic

changes.problem: The people are crude pale mannequins, and they are the single strongest CG tell in the frame.

changes.expected: Figures read as people blurred by a slow shutter, recede into the room's tones, and stop competing with the speakers

out_of_scope.request: Give the speakers a saturated tint so the frame has one colour
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration is fixed: EARF's products' colour is not a setting. In Smoke the frame is meant to have no saturated colour, so the speaker must win on light and position, not on hue

out_of_scope.request: Make the record-player lids read as thicker acrylic with polished glowing edges
out_of_scope.why: The R3 Float's parts are fixed EARF products; only their light (the lit base) can change

out_of_scope.request: Show board-formed concrete in this view
out_of_scope.why: The camera is the only lever, and it would change the frame's purpose (the counter run to the back bar); the room's materials are fixed
